articles.title: Surprise planning commission backs reduced setbacks for battery storage sites
articles.description: The Surprise Planning and Zoning Commission has approved a proposal that would allow large-scale battery energy storage facilities to be built closer to homes, a move supporters say will help expand renewable energy infrastructure but one that still raises concerns for some residents. The commission voted Thursday to approve a zoning text amendment that would reduce the required separation between battery energy storage systems, known as BESS, and residential areas.
